takeaway: Suxamethonium is a depolarizing neuromuscular blocker; blockers relax skeletal muscles so light anaesthesia can be used for surgery.

question.text: Which one of the following is a depolarizing neuromuscular blocker?
question.say: Which one of the following is a depolarizing neuromuscular blocker?

lines.text: Sux the superhero flies into the operating theatre.
lines.say: (laugh) Sux the superhero flies into the operating theatre, as a lightning bolt in goggles.
He strikes the neuromuscular junction, the meeting point of nerve and muscle.
Suxamethonium is a depolarizing neuromuscular blocker.

lines.text: The muscles relax and the patient is paralysed.
lines.say: Blocking the junction relaxes the skeletal muscles and induces paralysis.

lines.text: So light anaesthesia can be used, with relaxed abdominal muscles and diaphragm.
lines.say: That lets the anaesthetist use light levels of anaesthesia, with relaxation of the abdominal muscles and the diaphragm, which makes surgery easier.

lines.text: Remember: suxamethonium is the depolarizing blocker.
lines.say: Remember: suxamethonium is the depolarizing neuromuscular blocker.
